response.sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT SUM(Total) as customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId),overall_sum AS (SELECT SUM(Total) as total_revenue FROM Invoice),customer_shares AS (SELECT ct.customer_total, ct.customer_total / os.total_revenue as share FROM customer_totals ct CROSS JOIN overall_sum os),average_share_value AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM customer_shares),above_average_customers AS (SELECT cs.customer_total, cs.share, asv.avg_share FROM customer_shares cs CROSS JOIN average_share_value asv WHERE cs.share > asv.avg_share) SELECT AVG(aac.customer_total) as avg_amount_spent, AVG(aac.share) as avg_share, AVG(aac.share - aac.avg_share) as avg_share_beat FROM above_average_customers aac
